notes.title: Patch for Unity Games!
notes.notes:
Good day!

Today I bring you some improvements, patches, bugfixes. Shout out to Stephen for the reports!


 Fixed per-app volume scroll for games like Hero Siege, Last Epoch, Peak, and all Unity Games
 Snappier playback device change
 Other smaller fixes and QOL changes


Kind Regards,
Ed

notes.title: Minor Patch to Correct Default Language
notes.notes:
Ensured that the default language is set to English for unsupported languages.

Again, thank you for your reports and for your support :) The downloads doubled in the last week!

Kind Regards,
Ed

notes.title: Run-As-Admin Bugfix
notes.notes:
Run-as-admin caused the app to exit within 5 minutes after start-up, this has now been corrected. This patch will automatically be applied to your system if you have the setting on.

Thank you for the report :)
